title: Labor Schedule Clause — Warranty Drive Motor and Gearbox Replacement on Mobility Equipment
content:
# Labor on a Warranty Drive-Unit Replacement — Mobility Equipment

**Clause.** Summit Ridge claims from the chair manufacturer the labor of every drive motor or gearbox replacement done under the manufacturer's motor warranty on a Mobility Equipment chair, in whole 15-minute units, and posts that claim on the repair job. The units claimed for a warranty drive-unit replacement are the standard drive-unit allowance of 5 units.

| Claim | Units | Minutes of labor |
|---|---|---|
| warranty drive-unit replacement | 5 | 75 |

## Worked example (hypothetical)

A gearbox on a Group 2 Standard Power Wheelchair (K0823) is replaced under the manufacturer's motor warranty. The claim posted on that repair job is 5 whole units, 75 minutes of labor.

## Scope of the clause

The clause concerns a drive motor or gearbox replacement done under the manufacturer's motor warranty; the labor is claimed from the chair manufacturer in whole units.
